summary: A list of clickable menu items shown inside a panel, like a right-click context menu.
description: A menu/list container custom element that renders panel-item children, either as a native popover or, when embedded in a XUL <panel>, deferring positioning and open/close to that panel. No JSDoc; class PanelList is defined in the same file as PanelItem (panel-item). Corrected kind: PanelList extends plain HTMLElement (no XUL/MozElementMixin base), the same non-XUL heritage as panel-item, which this inventory already classifies as modern.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Reflected get/set property; observed attribute. Toggling it drives attributeChangedCallback, which calls onShow()/onHide() (alignment, popover show/hide, focus, hide-listener registration).

attributes.name: stay-open
attributes.description: get/set stayOpen. When present (and the anchor doesn't have a submenu), addHideListeners() is skipped entirely, so the panel never auto-dismisses; intended for inspecting panels/submenus in Storybook.

attributes.name: min-width-from-anchor
attributes.description: When present, setAlign() uses the anchor element's width (instead of the panel's own measured width) as the effective width for alignment, and sets min-width to the anchor's width.

attributes.name: popover
attributes.description: Managed internally by initializePopover()/show(): set to "auto" (light-dismissable) or "manual", or removed entirely when embedded in a XUL panel or acting as a submenu. Not meant to be set directly by consumers.

attributes.name: has-submenu
attributes.description: Set on the panel-list by a child panel-item when that item has a submenu, so submenu-specific layout CSS can apply. Internal state, not consumer-set.

attributes.name: align
attributes.description: Internal, computed by setAlign(): "left" or "right", recorded so CSS can position the panel relative to its anchor.

attributes.name: inxulpanel
attributes.description: Internal; reflects whether this panel-list is embedded inside a XUL <panel> (parentIsXULPanel()), which changes how positioning and open/close are handled.

attributes.name: showing
attributes.description: Internal, transient; set during layout measurement in setAlign()/setSubmenuAlign() to hide the panel until its position is computed, then removed.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: panel-item elements (and other content) rendered as the menu's items, inside the shadow DOM's .list container.

events.name: showing
events.description: Dispatched (bubbles, composed) at the start of onShow(), before alignment is computed or the popover is shown.

events.name: shown
events.description: Dispatched after the panel is visible, alignment/focus are settled, and (if opened via keyboard) the first item is focused.

events.name: hidden
events.description: Dispatched from onHide(), after the popover is hidden (or immediately if popover isn't supported).

methods.name: show
methods.description: show(triggeringEvent, target): opens the panel, computing alignment relative to the anchor/target and using the native popover API when supported (or a XUL panel's openPopup when embedded).

methods.name: hide
methods.description: hide(triggeringEvent, { force }, eventTarget): closes the panel; force bypasses the ui.popup.disable_autohide pref.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: toggle(triggeringEvent, target): calls show() or hide() depending on current open state.

cssProperties.name: --panel-list-background-color
cssProperties.description: Background color of the panel list.

cssProperties.name: --panel-list-border-color
cssProperties.description: Border color of the panel list.

cssProperties.name: --panel-list-border-radius
cssProperties.description: Corner radius of the panel list.

cssProperties.name: --panel-list-box-shadow
cssProperties.description: Drop shadow of the panel list.

cssProperties.name: --panel-list-text-color
cssProperties.description: Default text color for items in the list.
